name: Polar X-plorer
description: The fastest and most thrilling roller coaster at LEGOLAND Billund and the ride that Lonely Planet specifically recommends if you only have time for one coaster — Polar X-plorer is a spectacular indoor/outdoor coaster set in a dramatic arctic landscape complete with ice caves, frozen scenery and a genuinely surprising finale that catches even experienced riders off guard. The combination of outdoor speed, atmospheric ice cave sections and the surprise element makes Polar X-plorer the most complete and exhilarating coaster experience at any LEGOLAND park in Europe. Min. height: 110cm.

name: The Dragon
description: The beloved classic at the heart of LEGOLAND Billund — The Dragon takes riders on a magical journey through the enchanted Royal Castle before launching them into a thrilling outdoor coaster section with a breathtaking dragon flight through the medieval landscape. The combination of immersive indoor dark ride storytelling and genuine outdoor coaster thrills makes The Dragon perfectly accessible for families while delivering enough speed and excitement to satisfy older riders. A LEGOLAND Billund institution since 1985. Min. height: 100cm with adult, 120cm alone.

name: NINJAGO: The Ride
description: An innovative interactive dark ride where guests use hand gestures — no handheld devices needed — to shoot elemental powers at targets throughout the ride. NINJAGO: The Ride uses motion-tracking technology developed by Triotech to translate riders' real hand movements into on-screen attacks making it one of the most physically engaging and competitive interactive dark rides at any European theme park. Incredibly popular with families — the competitive scoring element keeps children returning for multiple rides. Suitable for all ages.

name: Miniland
description: The heart and soul of LEGOLAND Billund and the reason the park was created — Miniland is a breathtaking 1:20 scale recreation of Denmark and famous world landmarks built from over 20 million LEGO bricks. Visitors can walk through miniature versions of Copenhagen's Nyhavn, Skagen, Ribe, Danish royal palaces and international icons all assembled with extraordinary attention to detail and craftsmanship that took years to build. Miniland is the most historically significant area of any LEGOLAND park — the original vision that inspired all 10 LEGOLAND parks worldwide. A must-see for visitors of every age. Note: Miniland suffered fire damage in 2024 and is being progressively restored. Suitable for all ages.

name: The Temple
description: An immersive indoor dark ride adventure set in an ancient Egyptian temple where riders board Explorer SUVs equipped with laser guns and shoot at moving targets across 11 elaborately themed scenes. The Temple combines the tension of exploration with competitive laser-shooting gameplay making it one of the most replayable and engaging attractions at LEGOLAND Billund. The Egyptian theming, atmospheric lighting and interactive elements create an experience that genuinely improves with multiple visits as riders learn the optimal targets for maximum scores. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Haunted House Monster Party
description: A delightful interactive dark ride adventure where families join a monster party hosted by LEGO monsters — shooting at targets throughout the atmospheric haunted house setting to accumulate points and defeat the monsters. Haunted House Monster Party is one of LEGOLAND Billund's most beloved family attractions — accessible for young children while providing enough competitive gameplay to engage older visitors. The colourful LEGO monster theming makes it feel festive rather than frightening, perfect for families with younger children. Min. height: 90cm.

name: Vikings River Splash
description: A classic log flume water ride through a dramatic Viking-themed landscape of Norse settlements, longboats and dramatic river scenery before the inevitable splashing final drop. Vikings River Splash is one of LEGOLAND Billund's most popular summer attractions and delivers guaranteed soakings in an atmospheric setting that perfectly captures the Nordic spirit of the park's Danish heritage. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Pirates Splash Battle
description: An interactive water ride where riders board pirate boats and use water cannons to drench other boats and spectators on the shore — while being shot back at from water cannons along the route. Pirates Splash Battle is one of the most joyfully interactive and social attractions at LEGOLAND Billund, creating hilarious moments of aquatic warfare between complete strangers that perfectly embody the spirit of a great theme park. Min. height: 90cm.

name: Aquadome
description: A spectacular 360-degree water ride experience inside a dramatic aquatic dome — one of LEGOLAND Billund's most visually impressive attractions, combining the excitement of a water ride with extraordinary circular panoramic views of the underwater LEGO world that surrounds riders throughout. The Aquadome delivers a unique and memorable experience unlike any other water attraction in any European theme park. Min. height: 90cm.

name: Flying Eagle
description: A classic soaring eagle-themed ride in the LEGOREDO Western Town area where riders sit in eagle-shaped gondolas that sweep outward as the ride spins — delivering the sensation of soaring above the Wild West landscape below. Flying Eagle is a popular family ride that provides genuine excitement without the intensity of the coasters, making it ideal for families with children who are building their theme park confidence. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Apocalypse
description: A thrilling free-fall tower that sends riders slowly to the top before dropping them in a sudden stomach-dropping plunge — LEGOLAND Billund's most intense standalone thrill ride and a genuine adrenaline rush that provides a dramatically different experience from the family coasters. Apocalypse is popular with older children and adults who want something more intense while visiting with younger family members. Min. height: 120cm.

name: Jungle Racers
description: A fun jungle-themed jet ski ride in the Adventure Land area where riders board LEGO jet skis that spin and race through a vibrant jungle landscape at exciting speeds. Jungle Racers is consistently popular with older children who enjoy the slightly faster pace and spinning sensation — it sits perfectly between the gentle family rides and the more intense coasters. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Frog Hopper
description: A gentle bouncing frog-themed junior drop ride in Duplo Land — a perfectly sized thrill experience for very young children taking their first steps toward more exciting rides. Frog Hopper delivers small up-and-down bounces that children aged 3 and above absolutely love, with charming LEGO frog theming and a joyful atmosphere that makes it one of the most charming little attractions in the park. Min. height: 80cm.

name: Fire Academy
description: The most beloved participatory attraction at LEGOLAND Billund — families board fire trucks and must pump themselves to the scene of a fire by pulling on a rope, then battle the flames with water hoses. The fastest team wins. Fire Academy creates genuine family competition, physical effort and shared laughter in a way that no passive ride can replicate. Consistently one of the most memorable attractions for families visiting LEGOLAND Billund. Min. height: 90cm.

name: LEGO City Airport
description: An interactive LEGO City themed experience where families can pilot their own LEGO City aircraft through a take-off, fly-through and landing sequence — a hands-on aviation adventure that puts children in the pilot's seat and creates the ultimate LEGO City fantasy. City Airport is one of the most joyfully immersive experiences at LEGOLAND Billund and an absolute favourite with children who love LEGO City sets. Suitable for all ages.
